entries.german:
1436. 14. April. Krumau. — Rudger Abt uud der Convent des Klosters Golden- kron verkaufen dem ВuЛo von Ruben das Gut Ruben um 160 Schock Groschen.

CCXIII. My Ruthger opat a Dyetrzich przewor Jan klicznik klasstera Swate Coruny nassim y conuenta nasseho nynyeyssieho y buduczieho gmenem wyznawame wssem tiemto listem, ktoz gey czisty neb cztucze slissety biuln, ze sine s dobrim rozmislem a potazem prodaly a tiemto listem prodawame swe wsseczko prawo, kterez mame od Jesska Borowcze nebo sstyka z Rowneho, ktere sme od nyeho kupily za hotowe penieze, tocziss dwuor w Rownem, a plat, kteryz tu w Rownem miel se wssim toho dwora y toho platu przislussenstwim, nycz wynymagicz, s dyedymi, s lessi, potoki chrastmy, lukamy tak vplnye, yakoz on Borowecz a my po nyem drzaly, bezewsseho vmensseny, slowutnemu panossi Buzkowi s Rowneho geho erbum y buduczim za sto a za ssedesat kop grossow, kterez gest riam splnil vplnye penyezi hotowymi, a toho sme wsseho vplnye s stupily, y tiemto listem stupugem gemu y geho erbom y buduczim ku prawemu dyediczstwy. A slibugem tiemto listem dobru nassy wieru to swr- chupsane zbozie tak vplnye, yakoz nam od Boroweze z Rowneho we dezkach zemskich zapsano stogi, tak vplnye Buzkowi swrchupsa- nemu we dczki zemske wlozify, kdyzby dczky zemske bily otewrzieuy a knym przistup mohl byti.j Kdyby nas tyz Buzek vpomamil (sic) listem swim neb swim gistim posslem, po geho napomenuty prwnye neb druhe a konecznye na trzyetye suche dny bez dalssieho prod- lenye tak acz bichme samy nemohly ke dczkam przigety, tehda mame swim gistim possluom plnu mocz daty ke dezkam, aby ty nassy moczy wsseto vczinily, czoz bichme my inyely vczinity gsucze v desk samy, aneb aczbi desk nebylo, vtwrdyti a vpewnity tak, iakoz tu doba panya panossesobie trby a sbozie dyedyczna vtwrzowati a vpewnio- waty budu. A nevczinili bichme toho wsseho, czoz przedepsano stogy, tehdi dawame od sebe y odewssech buduczich swych przedepsanemu Buzkowi y geho buduczim tiemto listem plnu mocz, lidy nasse rzadnye stawowaty w miestech okolnych tak dluho, azbichme wsseczko vczi nily, czoz gest przedepsano. Take slibugem tuz nassy dobru wieru, ze wsseczky listy, kterez mame a moczy budem myety od Borowcze 267 na ten trch zbozie swrchupsaneho, mame daty Buzkowy dobrowolnye tak, ze on to wsseczko prawo ma k tomu wssemu zbozy, ezoz nahorze psano stogi, take ze sie odrzeczugem a zlawugem, y odpo- wiedame wsseho prawa, a czo sme drzewe myely k tomu zbozy przedepsanemu. A ktozbi kolywiek tento list midi s dobru woly Buzka swrchupsaneho, ten ma tez pniwo y tuz mocz ke wssem wie- czem swrchupsanym, yakozto on sam. Tomu nà gistotu swe peczeti opatowu y conuentsku przywiesilissme k tomillo listu a prosyli sme podcztyweho knyeze Zigmunda opata Wissnyobrodskeho a vrozeneho pana pana Oldrzioha z Rozmberka a slowutnych panossy Chwala s Chmelneho a Cztibora z Wlczetyna, ze su swe peczety podle nassieh na swyedomye wssem wieczem swrchupsanym k tomuto listu przi- wiesily. Genz gest dan w Crumlowie leta od narozenie syna bozieho tisiezieho cztyrzsteh trzidczateh ssesteho tu sobotu przed prowodem. Sechs, an Pergamentstreifen hängende Siegel. a} Ziemlich gross, in grünem Wachs. — Ein Abt mit Stab und Buch ¡n gothischer Capelle stehend; auf dem Postamente ein Schild oben mit einem gezähnten Querbalken (Krone?) — S . Rutgeri . Abbaus . Sancte Corone. b) Guldengross, beschädigt, in grünem Wachs. — Die gekrönte Maria mit dem Jesukinde auf einer Bank sitzend; rechts ein Leuchter sammt Kerze, links drei Sterne. — -j- S. Con- ventvs . See . Corone. c) Ziemlich gross, beschädigt, in grünem Wachs. — Goihische Capelle. — Sigill . . . Abbatis. I. entries.english:
14 April 1436, Krumau. Abbot Rudger and the convent of the monastery of Goldenkron sell the estate of Ruben to Buzko of Ruben for 160 schock of groschen.

CCXIII. I, Ruthger, abbot, and Dyetrzich, prior, and Jan, keykeeper of the monastery of St Corona, in the name of our present and future convent, declare to all by this letter, whoever may see it or hear it read, that after good consideration and counsel we have sold, and by this letter sell, all our rights which we have from Jessko Borowecz, [unclear designation] from Rowny, which we bought from him for ready money: namely, the manor at Rowny and the rent that he held there, with all the appurtenances of that manor and rent, including the homestead, woods, streams, thickets, and meadows, in full, just as Borowecz and we after him held them, without any diminution, to the worthy lord Buzko of Rowny, his heirs and successors, for 160 schock of groschen, which he has paid us in full in ready money. We have fully surrendered all this, and by this letter surrender it to him and his heirs and successors as a lawful inheritance.

By this letter we pledge our good faith that we shall enter the aforesaid property in the land books for the aforesaid Buzko just as fully as it stands recorded in the land books to us from Borowecz of Rowny, when the land books are open and access to them is possible. If the said Buzko summons us by his own letter or by a trusted messenger of his, then, after his first, second, and final summons, within three working days and without further delay, if we ourselves cannot go to the books, we shall authorize our trusted messenger to go to the books and do everything under our authority that we ourselves would have had to do in person before the books; or, if there are no books, to confirm and secure it as lords and nobles at that time confirm and secure purchases and hereditary property. If we fail to do all that is written above, then by this letter we give the aforesaid Buzko and his successors full authority on our behalf and that of all our future successors to billet our people in the surrounding towns for as long as it takes us to do everything prescribed.

We also pledge our good faith that all the documents we have, or may obtain, from Borowecz concerning the aforesaid sale of property shall be willingly delivered to Buzko, so that he has all rights to all the property described above. We also renounce and relinquish, and answer for, every right we previously held to the aforesaid property. Whoever holds this letter with the good will of the aforesaid Buzko shall have the same right and authority over all the aforesaid matters as he himself.

As assurance, we have attached our abbatial and conventual seals to this letter, and have asked the reverend priest Sigmund, abbot of Vyšší Brod, the noble lord Oldřich z Rožmberka, and the worthy lords Chval of Chmelná and Ctibor of Vlčetín to attach their seals alongside ours, as witnesses to all the aforesaid matters. Given at Krumlov in the year of the birth of the Son of God one thousand four hundred and thirty-six, on the Saturday before Palm Sunday.

Six seals hang from parchment strips. (a) Rather large, in green wax: an abbot standing with crozier and book in a Gothic chapel; on the pedestal, a shield with a notched horizontal band at the top (a crown?). Inscription: S. Rutgeri. Abbatis. Sancte Corone. (b) About the size of a gold coin, damaged, in green wax: the crowned Mary seated on a bench with the Christ Child; to the right a candlestick with a candle, to the left three stars. Inscription: S. Conventvs. Sce. Corone. (c) Rather large, damaged, in green wax: a Gothic chapel. Inscription: Sigill . . . Abbatis. I. Altouado. (d) Small, in red wax: a shield with a rose, above it a helmet with the same device. Inscription: Sigil. Vlrici. De. Rosenberg. (e) Small, in black wax: a shield with a lily, above it a helmet with a lily. Inscription: S. Chwaloni. De. Chemlin. Compare CCXII. (f) Small, in black wax: a shield with a falcon, above it a helmet with the same device. Inscription: Cztiborzal. Z. Wlczetnie.
